title: CreattleMon {S2}
description: Create and Cobblemon together for a perfect combo!
body:
##  Welcome to CreattleMon.

- This modpack is all about _The Create Mod and Cobblemon_.
- Explore a vast world with _Epic Terrain_ and more.
- Cook food with the [Let's Do] series and Farmer's delight.

PS, this pack was designed for a private server.
For the full experience, please join our discord server.
The discord is linked and applications are open!
# Enjoy.
-Bolletijger & Utzquishii
